主要内容: Optical Cable Corporation (OCC) announced on March 14, 2016, that all 20 claims of its U.S. patent application for printed circuit board technology enabling the Category 8 (Cat 8) performance standard in RJ-45 modular connectors were approved by the USPTO. The patent relates to printed circuit board and related technologies that enable the pending Category 8 performance standard in RJ-45 modular connectors. The technology allows 40-Gbit/second data transmission through twisted-pair copper cabling and utilizes non-continuous ground planes and layers of high and low dielectric materials to minimize cross-talk in RJ-45 connectors, ensuring backward compatibility with Category 6A standards. Dr. Ian Timmins, Vice President of Engineering, stated that the invention provides a cost-effective solution for high-speed Category 8 performance. The patent approval was disclosed in a press release issued on March 14, 2016, and attached as Exhibit 99.1 to the 8-K filing dated March 16, 2016. OCC has been a leader in copper data communications connectivity since acquiring SMP Data Communications in May 2008.
